title: Reviewing Operating Model for Korban Services in Singapore for Better Oversight
what_it_is: Reviewing Operating Model for Korban Services in Singapore for Better Oversight

sections.label: Delayed livestock affected korban services
sections.summary: On 21 May, MUIS was told of a delay in 400 livestock arriving, affecting korban services at four local mosques.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: To recap, on 21 May this year, the Islamic Religious Council of Singapore (Majlis Ugama Islam Singapura or MUIS) was informed of a delay in the arrival of 400 livestock, which affected local korban services at four local mosques.

sections.label: Measures to strengthen korban operating model
sections.summary: The speaker discussed findings and action plans with MUIS and will implement measures to strengthen the operating model and support korban operators.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: In the two weeks since I have stepped into this role, I have discussed the findings and action plans with MUIS, and we will implement concrete measures to strengthen the current operating model and better support local korban operators.

sections.label: Earlier engagements with mosques and vendors
sections.summary: Engagements with mosques and korban vendors will start six to eight months before Hari Raya Haji for regulatory approvals and planning.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister-in-charge of Muslim Affairs (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: Engagements with mosques and korban vendors will now start six to eight months before Hari Raya Haji to provide more time for overseas regulatory approvals and operational planning.

sections.label: Refunds and follow-up with Meat Brothers
sections.summary: Those with outstanding issues should contact MUIS, which will follow up with The Meat Brothers, who assured refunds by early August.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For those who still have outstanding issues or problems, please get in touch with MUIS, as we will do the follow up with The Meat Brothers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I have also been informed that The Meat Brothers have given their assurance that they will endeavour to settle all refunds by early August.

sections.label: Working with MFA and longer lead time
sections.summary: The speaker says they do not control Australia's processes but will work with MFA and give operators six to eight months of lead time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, in terms of process, we do not have control over Australia's processes, but we will endeavour to work with MFA to facilitate matters for our operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I am confident in the process where we are giving more lead time, which is six to eight months, to carry out the operations this time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We can hand-hold our operators to give assurance to our community, whereby we will provide a longer timeframe for the operators to obtain approval from the Australian Government.

sections.label: New operator and Australian supply chain
sections.summary: The Meat Brothers is a new operator unfamiliar with the environment, and Australian authorities took longer due to a new supply chain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The Meat Brothers is a new operator who is not so familiar with the environment and of course, it was also found that the authorities in Australia had also taken longer because they were operating with a new supply chain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, therefore, we are catering for such arrangements in future when there are new operators.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And therefore, we are giving more leeway and that is why we are extending the operations time now to six to eight months instead of what it is today.
